about: State Property as our crew performs it: one shot from one first frame (the meme's own opening, redrawn with Earl at the wheel and Mochi on the passenger seat). The driver's motion is the meme's own: DWPose's body, face and hands (take-N.kps.json, drawn as take-N.pose.mp4), kept as a person since Earl is one. Four takes run one after another, each starting on the frame where the one before it reaches their join, so the shot never jumps. The takes run shot-swap-dev.json with the pose as a ready-made control and the speech frozen in for the mouth; {Lead} and {Partner} are those roles' names and looks, {LeadName} the lead's name.

sound.note: The meme's own recording (the speech drove the mouth and played under the cut) is the original recording of a private person and is not shipped: our version's preview plays silent. A version made from this recipe follows a track Mixer makes in the trend's feel. A recipe that names a sound ("mix" for the cut, "vocals" for the mouths) uses it instead.

beats.text: Earl turns to the camera, an arm on the sill, and starts complaining
Earl leans on the sill, grimacing
Earl sits back and points away down the lane
Earl points again, then holds up a card

shots.prompt: Medium close-up through the open driver's window of a cream-yellow vintage pickup parked on an autumn lane, warm golden afternoon light. {Lead}, sits in the driver's seat and scolds the person filming from outside, looking straight at the camera, talking the whole time, mouth moving with every word. On the passenger seat sits {Partner}, unbothered, staring at the camera. {LeadName} turns to the camera with a forearm resting along the window sill and the other hand on the steering wheel, then leans toward the window, complaining. Polished 3D animated feature-film style. An indignant voice speaks, close to the camera.
